notes.title: The Hat Man Releases 1.0
notes.content:
Ten months after our first exposure to the public, we are releasing version 1.0. The game has added a ton of new features. We got so busy we did not even have time to post updates. This is huge.

In case you did not know, there have been only two of us working on the game for the last 10 months. We did it all by ourselves with the help of our Kickstarter and Early Access supporters. 

And we are not done yet. We will be listening to feedback and making improvements as we go. Here is part of the list of the latest improvements, many of which were requested by players:
[list]
[*] Save points.
[*] You can play as the Mother or Father
[*] Voice overs and subtitles for the parents
[*] More puzzles
[*] Shadow People now appear all over watching you
[*] New rooms
[*] New furniture
[*] The look changes as you progress
[*] More cinematic sequences
[*] Support for game controllers
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] More...
[/list]
Have fun digging around for all the "More..." it is not hard to find. And sometimes it will find you!

notes.title: The Hat Man Beta 0.8.5 Uploaded
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/291010]The Hat Man: Shadow Ward [/url] - This was a slightly unplanned update, but we found that under certain circumstances the elevator got broken and not on purpose. If you saw it, you are lucky! It did not happen often, but it was so late in the game we had to fix it.

So you get a new room and some new graphics free!

We are planning a bigger update for next week that will have more.

Thanks for your support. The Summer Sale is going great for us. Spread the word. This is going to be huge!

notes.title: Now 35% off The Hat Man: Shadow Ward is less than $10
notes.content: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/291010]The Hat Man: Shadow Ward[/url] - Now available at its lowest price ever, this horror survival game is getting tremendous support from the Steam community. A truly indie title being worked on by just a couple guys, it has wow'd people with its scary gameplay and interesting puzzles. Finishing the game is no easy task. Finishing it without jumping and swearing is almost impossible. Can you do it?

notes.title: Update Beta 0.8.4 with more fire!
notes.content:
We just posted our update and it is hot! We added a little fire to this release. 
[b]Highlights of this release:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Hat Man is tougher
[*] All the in-game tasks work
[*] Fixed issues with the journal, lighting and sound
[*] Clicking on items and tasks is now easier
[*] Added a telegram up front to launch the story off
[/list]
As always, let us know what you think. We love hearing from you and have incorporated a few suggestions already.
